title: PAR-20/7G.3 SCALE/MLINESTYLE key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit generated SCALE and MLINESTYLE OBJECTS graphs for unique root keys and section-wide handle identity.
Require owner-0 NOD identity, exact normalized/exact root-key cardinality, and exact child dictionary name/handle relationships.
Reuse existing ASCII/Binary named-resource route and its focused CTest.

sourceChange.change: rootScaleWriterClosure now counts normalized ACAD_SCALELIST entries, checks exact 1:10/1:20 dictionary names, owner-zero NOD, and unique OBJECTS handles; rootMLineStyleWriterClosure now counts ACAD_MLINESTYLE entries and checks owner-zero NOD and unique OBJECTS handles.
sourceChange.reason: Existing child semantic and local ordering checks did not reject duplicate root keys or unrelated duplicate OBJECTS identities, and the NOD's owner-zero invariant was not asserted on these output routes.
